$comment: Only ay.* fields appear here. The inherited gm.* fields resolve from
protocol.general_medicine.json — the same question, translated once.
Wording rule for this bundle: ask in everyday language about what the
patient can actually observe about themselves. Never ask a patient to name
their own Prakriti or a Samprapti stage — that determination is the

ay.dv.prakriti.body_frame.voice_prompt: First, a few questions about your body's natural nature. How would you describe your body build, as it has been most of your life?
ay.dv.prakriti.body_frame.help: Think about how you have been for most of your life, not just now.

ay.dv.prakriti.skin_nature.help: Again, think about how it usually is, not only today.

ay.dv.prakriti.appetite_nature.help: Think about your normal pattern over the years.

ay.dv.prakriti.temperament.voice_prompt: How would you describe your nature — how you usually think and feel?
ay.dv.prakriti.temperament.help: There is no better or worse answer. Choose what fits you.

ay.dv.prakriti.tolerance_to_climate.voice_prompt: Which kind of weather do you find hardest to bear?
ay.dv.prakriti.tolerance_to_climate.help: Choose the one that troubles you most.

ay.dv.vikriti.current_disturbance.voice_prompt: Now, what feels different from your usual self these days? You can choose more than one.
ay.dv.vikriti.current_disturbance.help: This is about the present time, compared with how you normally feel.

ay.dv.sara.stamina.voice_prompt: How is your strength and stamina these days?
ay.dv.sara.stamina.help: Think about whether you tire faster than you used to.

ay.dv.samhanana.build_quality.voice_prompt: How would you describe your body at present?
ay.dv.samhanana.build_quality.help: This is about now, including any recent change in weight.

ay.dv.pramana.height_cm.voice_prompt: What is your height in centimetres, if you know it? You may skip this if you are not sure.
ay.dv.pramana.height_cm.help: An approximate number is fine. You may skip this question.

ay.dv.pramana.weight_kg.voice_prompt: What is your weight in kilograms, if you know it? You may skip this if you are not sure.
ay.dv.pramana.weight_kg.help: An approximate number is fine. You may skip this question.

ay.dv.satmya.tolerances.voice_prompt: Are there foods or habits that do not suit you?
ay.dv.satmya.tolerances.help: This means foods that regularly upset you, not a one-time problem.

ay.dv.sattva.mental_resilience.voice_prompt: How do you usually cope with worry or difficulty?
ay.dv.sattva.mental_resilience.help: Please answer honestly. This helps the doctor understand you fully.

ay.dv.ahara_shakti.capacity.voice_prompt: How is your hunger and digestion at present?
ay.dv.ahara_shakti.capacity.help: Think about whether you feel hungry, and whether food feels heavy afterwards.

ay.dv.ahara_shakti.bowel_pattern.help: Choose the one closest to your usual pattern these days.

ay.dv.vyayama_shakti.capacity.voice_prompt: How much physical work can you do without difficulty?
ay.dv.vyayama_shakti.capacity.touch_label: How much work can you do?
ay.dv.vyayama_shakti.capacity.help: Think about climbing stairs or walking a distance.

ay.dv.vaya.life_stage.voice_prompt: Which stage of life are you in?
ay.dv.vaya.life_stage.help: Choose childhood, adult, or old age.

ay.av.rasa_preference.voice_prompt: Which tastes do you like most in your food? You can choose more than one.
ay.av.rasa_preference.help: Choose the tastes you naturally reach for.

ay.av.meal_regularity.voice_prompt: Do you eat your meals at regular times?
ay.av.meal_regularity.help: Think about a normal week for you.

ay.av.water_intake.voice_prompt: About how much water do you drink in a day?
ay.av.water_intake.help: One litre is about four glasses.

ay.av.nidra_pattern.voice_prompt: How is your sleep pattern? You can choose more than one.
ay.av.nidra_pattern.help: Include daytime sleep if you take it.

ay.av.dinacharya.voice_prompt: Do you follow any of these daily practices?
ay.av.dinacharya.help: Choose all that you actually do regularly.

ay.av.vega_dharana.voice_prompt: Do you often hold back any of these natural urges?
ay.av.vega_dharana.help: For example, holding urine because of work. Choose all that apply.

ay.nid.causative_factors.voice_prompt: What do you think may have brought on this problem?
ay.nid.causative_factors.help: Your own idea is useful to the doctor. Choose all that apply, or 'I am not sure'.

ay.nid.onset_season.voice_prompt: In which season did this problem start?
ay.nid.onset_season.help: You may skip this if you do not remember.

ay.sam.progression_pattern.voice_prompt: How has this problem developed since it began?
ay.sam.progression_pattern.help: Choose whichever is closest to what you have experienced.

ay.sam.previous_ayush_treatment.voice_prompt: Have you already taken any treatment for this problem?
ay.sam.previous_ayush_treatment.help: Include home remedies and English medicine as well. Choose all that apply.
